sentences.en: All that's required is one injection and some electronic devices.
sentences.zh: 只需要一次注射和一些电子设备。

sentences.en: Electronic components can be cleaned by using pure isopropyl alcohol.
sentences.zh: 可以用纯异丙醇清洁电子元件。

sentences.en: When a new electronic device is released, everyone goes crazy.
sentences.zh: 每当有新的电子产品发布时，大家都会疯狂抢购。
